Maths Path · Ages 6 to 7

Class 2 maths

Hundreds, equal groups, lines and data. Go in order. Pass each check to open the next chapter.

0 of 9 passed

Class 2 chapters in order

  1. 1

    Hundreds, tens and ones

    Build, compare and say three-digit numbers like 342.

    • I can read hundreds, tens and ones.
    • I can order and compare numbers.
    • I can match a three-digit number to its written name.
    Not started
  2. 2

    Add, subtract and make equal groups

    Add and take away with swaps, count equal groups and find the missing part.

    • I can add and subtract in a story.
    • I can count equal groups.
    • I can find a missing digit or amount.
    Not started
  3. 3

    Find number and picture rules

    Spot the rule in number rows and growing pictures, then use it again.

    • I can continue a number series.
    • I can continue a growing picture.
    • I can use the same rule for a new number.
    Not started
  4. 4

    Lines, shapes and solids

    Count lines and shapes carefully, describe solids and finish a mirror picture.

    • I can count lines and shapes.
    • I can describe a solid.
    • I can complete a reflected picture.
    Not started
  5. 5

    Length, weight, capacity and temperature

    Measure from zero, compare weight and capacity, and read a thermometer.

    • I can measure and compare lengths.
    • I can compare weight and capacity.
    • I can compare thermometer readings.
    Not started
  6. 6

    Clocks, dates and how long

    Read clocks to the quarter hour, work out how long, and use a calendar.

    • I can match a clock to a time.
    • I can work out how long something takes.
    • I can use a calendar or timetable.
    Not started
  7. 7

    Shop, save and find change

    Make amounts with notes and coins, find change and keep track of savings.

    • I can make an amount with notes and coins.
    • I can find a missing price or change.
    • I can compare purchases within a budget.
    Not started
  8. 8

    Read picture charts

    Read picture graphs, compare the groups and check statements about data.

    • I can use a pictograph key.
    • I can compare chart values.
    • I can check a statement about data.
    Not started
  9. 9

    Codes, hidden shapes and order

    Find the odd one out, read simple codes, spot hidden shapes and find places in a row.

    • I can group pictures and use an analogy.
    • I can use a code key to read a message.
    • I can find an exact shape hidden in a picture.
    • I can find a place in a row.
    Not started
